people.name: Ashdod
people.line: A major Philistine city, known for Dagon worship.

people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the seven deacons, evangelized in Samaria

translations.web: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.
translations.bsb: But Philip appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
translations.kjv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
translations.asv: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached the gospel to all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
